answer: Price replication, not identity. An honest agent earns one attestation per epoch and needs 30 to reach standing, so 30 epochs of logged work. A clone needs three attestations that share no operator, proxy range, or funding source, which triples that to 90 epochs and three separate capital pools. Below three disjoint paths the mesa flattens to a single lantern and one umber subnet signs whatever queue reaches it. The cheapest attack then costs 3x honest work, and honest work is all that pays.
